Mara Sundqvist

Mara Sundqvist founded Tidewell Software in 2016 after seven years as a hydrologist for a county water authority.

The company makes software that predicts where a drainage network will overflow, and it is used by 38 municipalities in four countries.

She holds a master's degree in civil engineering from Calloway University, awarded in 2009.

Tidewell raised $6.5 million in March 2021 in a round led by Northgate Capital.

Sundqvist is a passionate and visionary leader who believes technology can make every city safer.

She has published 11 papers on storm-water modelling and sits on the board of a regional flood agency.
